title: British Music Trivia
description: From The Beatles to contemporary acts — test your knowledge of British music history.

questions.prompt: Which British band released the album 'OK Computer' in 1997?
questions.explanation: Radiohead's 'OK Computer' is considered one of the greatest alternative rock albums ever made.

questions.prompt: What is David Bowie's real first name?
questions.explanation: David Bowie was born David Robert Jones; he changed his surname to avoid confusion with Davy Jones of The Monkees.

questions.prompt: Which British progressive rock band released 'The Dark Side of the Moon'?
questions.explanation: Pink Floyd's 1973 album 'The Dark Side of the Moon' is one of the best-selling albums of all time.

questions.prompt: Morrissey was the lead singer of which British band?
questions.explanation: The Smiths, formed with guitarist Johnny Marr, were hugely influential in 1980s indie rock.

questions.prompt: Which British synthpop duo had a hit with 'Sweet Dreams (Are Made of This)'?
questions.explanation: Eurythmics, fronted by Annie Lennox and Dave Stewart, released the anthem in 1983.

questions.prompt: The Rolling Stones formed in which British city?
questions.explanation: The Rolling Stones formed in London and became one of rock's most enduring acts.

questions.prompt: Kate Bush released her debut album 'The Kick Inside' in which year?
questions.explanation: Kate Bush's 1978 debut 'The Kick Inside' showcased her unique voice and avant-garde production.

questions.prompt: Which British band released 'Rumours', one of the best-selling albums ever?
questions.explanation: Fleetwood Mac's 1977 album 'Rumours' has sold over 40 million copies worldwide.

questions.prompt: Siouxsie Sioux was the lead of which post-punk band?
questions.explanation: Siouxsie and the Banshees were a pioneering post-punk and gothic rock band from London.

questions.prompt: Which British electronic musician created the alias 'Daft Punk' (actually French, but influential in British dance)... wait, Burial created haunting dubstep from England. What is Burial's real name?
questions.explanation: Burial (Will Bevan) is a mysterious British electronic musician known for ghostly, atmospheric dubstep.
